name: week
title: Vending: this week
subtitle: What needs a person, and which machines are due

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select item, what, why, due from attention order by due, item

sections.title: Machines due in the next two days
sections.sql: select machine, site, route, kind, last_visit, next_due, days_overdue from machine_due where next_due <= current_date + 2 order by next_due, machine

sections.title: Open service calls
sections.sql: select c.code as call, m.code as machine, s.name as site, c.opened_on, c.issue from service_calls c join machines m on m.id = c.machine_id join sites s on s.id = m.site_id where c.status = 'open' order by c.opened_on

name: money
title: Vending money
subtitle: Cash against the counts, machine earnings and host commission

sections.title: Cash and card that do not match the counts
sections.sql: select visit, machine, visit_date, driver, currency, expected_cents, cash_cents, cashless_cents, variance_cents from cash_variance order by visit_date desc
sections.note: Expected is what the slot counts say sold, at the price on the slot. A shortfall can be a cash box, a coin jam, a wrong count or a price set differently on the machine.

sections.title: Machines, last 28 days
sections.sql: select machine, site, kind, currency, units, weekly_sales_cents, waste_cents, margin_cents from machine_performance order by weekly_sales_cents

sections.title: Host commission by month
sections.sql: select site, name, month, currency, collected_cents, commission_cents, paid_cents, (commission_cents - paid_cents) as owed_cents from site_commission order by month desc, site

name: stock
title: Vending stock
subtitle: What to load, what is near its date and what the warehouse holds

sections.title: To load for machines due by tomorrow
sections.sql: select route, product, product_name, sum(to_fill)::int as units, count(distinct machine)::int as machines from pick_needs where next_due <= current_date + 1 group by route, product, product_name order by route, product

sections.title: Near or past its date in a machine
sections.sql: select machine, slot, product_name as product, date_mark, use_by, days_left from expiry order by use_by

sections.title: Warehouse
sections.sql: select product, name, on_hand, earliest_date, fleet_daily_rate as sells_a_day, days_cover from warehouse order by days_cover nulls last
